Name: Snake360 Lite
Overview:
A budget re-release of Snake360. The price was reduced from 240 MS Points to 80. To fit the new pricing model, some changes to the game were made.

Main mode courses have been reduced from 6 to 3,
Main mode difficulties have been reduced from 5 to 3.
Total number of levels have been reduced from 300 to 90.
Survival/Battle levels have been reduced from 12 to 6.
Internet Ranking Leaderboards have been reduced from 59 to 21
The removal of the Music Player, Turbo/Extreme speeds, Co-Op Mode (2P), Competition Mode (2P), Marathon Mode (1P). and Practice Mode (1P)
